Exchanges for a different size or color are free of charge. If you need help with the process, let me know!Agent saidWelcome to Life Is Good! How can I help you today?You saidHi! I'm shopping but not sure what's right for me, can you help me choose?Agent saidAbsolutely, I’d be happy to help! To get started, could you tell me a bit about what you’re looking for? For example:Are you shopping for yourself or someone else?Is there a particular type of product you’re interested in (like t-shirts, hats, mugs, etc.)?Do you have a favorite color, style, or theme?Are you looking for something casual, sporty, or for a specific occasion?Let me know what matters most to you, and I’ll help you find the perfect fit!You saidI want something for everyday use, good quality, and I care about value for money.Agent saidThanks for sharing what matters to you! For everyday use, great quality, and value for money, our Crusher Tees are a top choice. They’re made from USA-grown cotton, praised for their softness, durability, and comfort, and come in a variety of colors and styles. Many customers mention they last for years and hold up well after washing.If you prefer a lighter option, the Crusher-LITE Tees offer the same comfort in a lighter weight. Both are designed for daily wear and are considered a great value.Would you like recommendations for short sleeve, long sleeve, or both? And do you have a favorite color or style (solid, graphic, or themed)? Let me know so I can help you narrow it down!You saidI'd like to stay within a sensible budget, what are my best options?Agent saidThanks for sharing your priorities! For everyday use and value for money, our Crusher and Crusher-LITE Tees are excellent options. They’re made from USA-grown cotton, known for softness and durability, and most are priced between $17.99 and $29.95. There are also sale styles starting as low as $9.99.If you’d like, I can recommend specific short or long sleeve tees, or help you find the best deals. Are you shopping for men’s, women’s, or both? And do you prefer solid colors or graphic designs? Let me know so I can tailor suggestions for you!You saidCan you compare your two most popular options and tell me which is better for me?Agent saidHere’s a quick comparison of our two most popular options for everyday use and value:Crusher Tee: This is our classic, heavyweight tee made from 100% USA-grown cotton (or 80/20 cotton/poly for heather colors). It’s garment washed for softness, durable, and holds up well after repeated washing. It’s a customer favorite for comfort and longevity, with prices starting around $17.99–$29.95.Crusher-LITE Tee: This is a lighter-weight version of the Crusher, also made from USA-grown cotton. It’s just as soft and comfortable, but a bit lighter and cooler for warmer days. It’s also priced in the same range, and customers love it for its versatility and all-day comfort.If you want a tee that feels substantial and lasts for years, the Crusher is a great choice. If you prefer something lighter for hot weather or layering, Crusher-LITE is ideal.Would you like recommendations for men’s or women’s styles, and do you prefer solid colors or graphics? Let me know so I can help you pick the best fit for your needs!You saidWhich one is your overall best seller, and is it well reviewed?Agent saidOur overall best seller is the Crusher Tee, which has been a customer favorite for over 20 years. It’s made from USA-grown cotton, known for its softness and durability, and is designed for everyday comfort. Reviews consistently praise its quality, fit, and longevity—many customers mention they’ve worn these tees for years…
